author: Inside Edition
description: Captain Chesley "Sully" Sullenberger reveals he has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's. The nation's beloved pilot earned fame when he safely landed a jetliner in New York’s Hudson River after a bird strike crippled the aircraft, saving everyone on board in 2009. It became known as the "Miracle on the Hudson." Captain Sully is now 75 and says he won’t let the disease stop him from living his life.
title: 'Miracle On The Hudson' Pilot Captain Sully Reveals Alzheimer's Diagnosis

description: Senator Mitch McConnell's office released a photo of the senator to combat rumors that he was dead. The photo shows McConnell in a hospital with his wife by his side and a fresh copy of The Washington Post in his lap. Many are wondering if the photo is real. Inside Edition had AI expert Stephen Stamm take a look at the photo.
title: Some Question If Senator Mitch McConnell's 'Proof-Of-Life' Photo Is Real

author: Inside Edition
description: People took to the streets of a small town in Maine, after ICE agents reportedly shot and killed a man there on Monday. CBS News reports that 26-year-old Joan Sebastian Guerrero died after being shot by Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents in Biddeford, Maine. Guerrero was from Colombia, and had been given an order to leave the country. Angus King, the independent US senator from Maine, told reporters that Guerrero was not the person ICE agents had been seeking.
title: ICE Agents Kill Man In Maine
